'''Colin Simmons''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 1999 Newcastle tournament]] on 22 August 1999 with TIE deck, according to Iain Reid's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d20">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-25-glasgow-uk-8-21-99-and-newcastle-uk-8-22-99d20/ glasgow-uk-8-21-99-and-newcastle-uk-8-22-99], DeckTech (Iain "Corpboy" Reid, 25 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-25-glasgow-uk-8-21-99-and-newcastle-uk-8-22-99d20/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
